title: Uruguayan Pork Bake
description: A hearty, earthy, and juicy Uruguayan-inspired dish featuring minced pork, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is also pescatarian-friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the minced pork, onion, garlic, cilantro, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Mix well with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Add the egg to the bowl and mix until the mixture is just holding together.
Transfer the mixture to a ttukbaegi (Korean earthenware pot) or a similar heat-proof dish and smooth the top.
Bake the mixture in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until lightly browned on the bottom.
Remove the dish from the oven and top with grated cheddar cheese and Korean chili flakes.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Slice the Uruguayan Pork Bake into wedges and serve hot.
Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
